cars.specification_market: 1963 USA Galaxie 500 Sports Hardtop with optional dual-carb 425-bhp 427 and selected four-speed manual, revised December 1962 factory catalogue. Use the 500 body leaf, not XL bucket-seat trim or sedan dimensions. Retain factory advertised bhp/native units without a modern net/kW conversion. No lightweight body materials, race output, top speed, curb weight, installed axle ratio or power assistance inferred. Count the 1960–1964 performance-road Galaxie family once across years, roofs and engines.
cars.summary: The Galaxie 427 Sports Hardtop is a defining full-size American muscle-car programme, combining dual-quad FE V8 performance with a purposeful chassis package and the fastback body associated with Ford’s racing effort. An independent first-hand historical evaluation supports its performance significance while distinguishing road cars from lightweight competition specials.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The Galaxie 427 Sports Hardtop is a defining full-size American muscle-car programme, combining dual-quad FE V8 performance with a purposeful chassis package and the fastback body associated with Ford’s racing effort. An independent first-hand historical evaluation supports its performance significance while distinguishing road cars from lightweight competition specials.
